showcase.user_prompt: 帮我规划一部长篇小说，并把第一章写入项目文件。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我会结合插件提供的写作 Skill、动态提示词和文件工具完成规划与写作。

blocks.title: 完整演示外置插件扩展能力

items.title: 全局界面插槽
items.description: 在应用全局区域渲染可信的插件界面，并跟随宿主主题。

items.title: 动态 Agent 提示词
items.description: 根据插件设置增加、替换、更新、停用或移除写作提示块。

items.title: Skill 与工具控制
items.description: 贡献小说大纲 Skill、工具策略以及可写入章节文件的自定义工具。

items.title: 自动续接演示
items.description: 按需启用一次性的后续写作请求，演示会话续接能力。

showcase.user_prompt: Outline a novel and write its first chapter into the project.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll combine the plugin’s writing Skill, dynamic prompt, and file tool to plan and draft it.

blocks.title: A complete external plugin extension demo

items.title: Global UI slot
items.description: Renders trusted plugin UI in a global app surface and follows the host theme.

items.title: Dynamic Agent prompt
items.description: Adds, replaces, updates, disables, or removes writing prompt blocks from settings.

items.title: Skill and tool controls
items.description: Contributes a fiction-outline Skill, tool policy, and a custom chapter-writing tool.

items.title: Continuation demo
items.description: Optionally injects one follow-up writing request to demonstrate conversation continuation.
